record.dic_text:
052 'Abiyshay {a-vi:-shai'} 或 (縮寫型) 'Abshay {av-shai'}

源自 SNH00001 和 SNH07862; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Abishai 25; 25

亞比篩 = "我父是耶西" 或 "我父是禮物"
1) 耶西的孫子, 大衛王的外甥 (大衛的姐姐洗魯雅所生), 約押的兄弟
record.edic_text:
052 'Abiyshay {ab-ee-shah'ee} or (shorter) 'Abshay {ab-shah'ee}

from 01 and 07862;; n pr m

AV - Abishai 25; 25

Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift"
1) grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah,
   brother of Joab
